analyst.summary: Craftsman Automation makes auto and industrial components, with its Aluminium Products division (now 61% of revenue) growing fast enough that the plant is running near 85% capacity -- prompting a new Hosur facility and a Rs 2,000 crore equity raise. Revenue is up 36% and profit more than doubled in the latest quarter, but the company carries more debt than most peers in this review (D/E ~1.1, thin ~4x interest cover) and the stock already trades at a rich ~57x earnings. We rate it a Hold: genuinely strong growth, but priced for it, and more leveraged than we'd like to see before adding.
